name: GO-1 / GO-1 Air
architecture: VLM plus latent-action planner plus diffusion action expert; Air removes planner
action_representation: Discrete latent plan; continuous action chunks
training: Latent action reconstruction/prediction followed by robot action denoising
data: Human video, cross-embodiment robot data and AgiBot World
inference: Predict latent plan then denoise action chunk and execute with feedback
contribution: Separates transfer of video motion knowledge from embodiment-specific continuous execution
limitations: Latent plan quality, embodiment alignment, data concentration and task-limited results
openness: Code and listed checkpoints/dataset releases; exact training reproducibility must be audited

name: SERL
inputs: Visual observation, robot state and reward
architecture: Off-policy actor-critic training and robot learning infrastructure
training: Sample-efficient real-world RL with prior demonstrations or experience
inference: Learned actor executes within the robot control stack
limitations: Reward/reset design and interaction burden; not one universal pretrained model

name: HIL-SERL
inputs: Images, state, learned success reward and human corrections
architecture: Reward classifier, demonstration/replay buffers, actor-learner loop
action_representation: Continuous control through task-specific robot interface
training: Reward learning from positives/negatives, demonstrations and online off-policy RL with interventions
data: Task-specific demonstrations, success labels and online interventions
inference: Actor controls robot; human corrections become experience
contribution: Uses failure recovery and feedback beyond pure imitation
limitations: Human/reset cost, reward misspecification, narrow task protocols
openness: Code and workflows available; hardware-specific integration required

name: MolmoAct2
architecture: Molmo2-ER embodied reasoning backbone plus continuous flow-matching action expert
training: Molmo2-ER backbone -> discrete autoregressive MolmoAct2-Pretrain -> flow-matching action expert; MolmoAct2-Think is a separate depth-token-reasoning variant.
data: Released reasoning and robot training datasets, with embodiment-specific adaptation
inference: Closed-loop manipulation using conditioned action expert
contribution: Combines open embodied reasoning assets with continuous robot action learning
limitations: Reasoning metrics alone do not establish contact reliability; base checkpoints are not universal deployment policies
openness: Official code, models, staged checkpoints and dataset links

name: Xiaomi-Robotics-0
architecture: Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct VLM plus diffusion transformer; 4.7B total per official page
training: Choice-policy VLM training; freeze VLM and train flow expert; prefix-conditioned post-training
data: Robot and vision-language mixtures plus task-specific teleoperation
inference: Buffered asynchronous chunks with committed prefix alignment
contribution: Treats deployment scheduling and action responsiveness as training-design issues
limitations: Requires matching async checkpoint, valid normalization, hardware adaptation and task data
openness: Code, weights and full post-training pipeline announced April 2026
